subject: Number of cars
author: Xandu
body:
So far the total number of cars is 81 (including the french car) but there might still be more cars to be had.

US Total is 80.
French total is 76 provided they can't get the Steel wheels car.
UK total is 76.

Rest of the world is probably 75 unless there are other special cars we don't know about.
